scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.dev: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.package: npm run lint && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm run package
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm run package
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm run package
